title: erysimum runcinatum
intro: Erysimum runcinatum, commonly known as 'Bastard Cress' or 'Tournesol', is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family, known for its fragrant, yellow flowers and edible leaves. The health benefits of Erysimum runcinatum include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and provide antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antibacterial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Erysimum runcinatum include isothiocyanates, glucosinolates, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
